잠언-25-1.title: 잠언 25장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-1.exegesis: 32-34. From the folly of the sluggard learn wisdom ( Pr 6:10 , 11 ).
잠언-25-1.theologicalNote: 32-34. From the folly of the sluggard learn wisdom ( Pr 6:10 , 11 ).

잠언-25-2.title: 잠언 25장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 25 Pr 25:1-28 . 1. The character of these proverbs sustains the title (see Introduction). also-- refers to the former part of the book. copied out-- literally, "transferred," that is, from some other book to this; not given from memory.
잠언-25-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 25 Pr 25:1-28 . 1. The character of these proverbs sustains the title (see Introduction). also-- refers to the former part of the book. copied out-- literally, "transferred," that is, from some other book to this; not given from memory.

잠언-25-3.title: 잠언 25장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-3.exegesis: 2. God's unsearchableness impresses us with awe (compare Is 45:15 ; Ro 11:33 ). But kings, being finite, should confer with wise counsellors;
잠언-25-3.theologicalNote: 2. God's unsearchableness impresses us with awe (compare Is 45:15 ; Ro 11:33 ). But kings, being finite, should confer with wise counsellors;

잠언-25-4.title: 잠언 25장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-4.exegesis: 3. Ye wisely keeping state secrets, which to common men are as inaccessible heights and depths.
잠언-25-4.theologicalNote: 3. Ye wisely keeping state secrets, which to common men are as inaccessible heights and depths.

잠언-25-5.title: 잠언 25장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-5.exegesis: 4-5. As separating impurities from ore leaves pure silver, so taking from a king wicked counsellors leaves a wise and beneficent government.
잠언-25-5.theologicalNote: 4-5. As separating impurities from ore leaves pure silver, so taking from a king wicked counsellors leaves a wise and beneficent government.

잠언-25-6.title: 잠언 25장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-6.exegesis: 4-5. As separating impurities from ore leaves pure silver, so taking from a king wicked counsellors leaves a wise and beneficent government.
잠언-25-6.theologicalNote: 4-5. As separating impurities from ore leaves pure silver, so taking from a king wicked counsellors leaves a wise and beneficent government.

잠언-25-7.title: 잠언 25장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-7.exegesis: 6-7. Do not intrude into the presence of the king, for the elevation of the humble is honorable, but the humbling of the proud disgraceful ( Lu 14:8-10 ).
잠언-25-7.theologicalNote: 6-7. Do not intrude into the presence of the king, for the elevation of the humble is honorable, but the humbling of the proud disgraceful ( Lu 14:8-10 ).

잠언-25-8.title: 잠언 25장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-8.exegesis: 6-7. Do not intrude into the presence of the king, for the elevation of the humble is honorable, but the humbling of the proud disgraceful ( Lu 14:8-10 ).
잠언-25-8.theologicalNote: 6-7. Do not intrude into the presence of the king, for the elevation of the humble is honorable, but the humbling of the proud disgraceful ( Lu 14:8-10 ).

잠언-25-9.title: 잠언 25장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-9.exegesis: 8. (Compare Pr 3:30 ). lest ... shame-- lest you do what you ought not, when shamed by defeat, or "lest thou art shut out from doing any thing."
잠언-25-9.theologicalNote: 8. (Compare Pr 3:30 ). lest ... shame-- lest you do what you ought not, when shamed by defeat, or "lest thou art shut out from doing any thing."

잠언-25-10.title: 잠언 25장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-10.exegesis: 9-10. (Compare Mt 5:25 , Margin). secret-- that is, of your opponent, for his disadvantage, and so you be disgraced, not having discussed your difficulties with him.
잠언-25-10.theologicalNote: 9-10. (Compare Mt 5:25 , Margin). secret-- that is, of your opponent, for his disadvantage, and so you be disgraced, not having discussed your difficulties with him.

잠언-25-11.title: 잠언 25장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-11.exegesis: 9-10. (Compare Mt 5:25 , Margin). secret-- that is, of your opponent, for his disadvantage, and so you be disgraced, not having discussed your difficulties with him.

잠언-25-12.title: 잠언 25장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-12.exegesis: 11. a word fitly-- literally, "quickly," as wheels roll, just in time. The comparison as apples ... silver gives a like sense. apples, &c.-- either real apples of golden color, in a silver network basket, or imitations on silver embroidery.
잠언-25-12.theologicalNote: 11. a word fitly-- literally, "quickly," as wheels roll, just in time. The comparison as apples ... silver gives a like sense. apples, &c.-- either real apples of golden color, in a silver network basket, or imitations on silver embroidery.

잠언-25-13.title: 잠언 25장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-13.exegesis: 12. Those who desire to know and do rightly, most highly esteem good counsel ( Pr 9:9 ; 15:31 ). The listening ear is better than one hung with gold.
잠언-25-13.theologicalNote: 12. Those who desire to know and do rightly, most highly esteem good counsel ( Pr 9:9 ; 15:31 ). The listening ear is better than one hung with gold.

잠언-25-14.title: 잠언 25장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-14.exegesis: 13. Snow from mountains was used to cool drinks; so refreshing is a faithful messenger ( Pr 13:17 ).
잠언-25-14.theologicalNote: 13. Snow from mountains was used to cool drinks; so refreshing is a faithful messenger ( Pr 13:17 ).

잠언-25-15.title: 잠언 25장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-15.exegesis: 14. clouds-- literally, "vapors" ( Jr 10:13 ), clouds only in appearance. a false gift-- promised, but not given.
잠언-25-15.theologicalNote: 14. clouds-- literally, "vapors" ( Jr 10:13 ), clouds only in appearance. a false gift-- promised, but not given.

잠언-25-16.title: 잠언 25장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-16.exegesis: 15. Gentleness and kindness overcome the most powerful and obstinate. long forbearing-- or, "slowness to anger" ( Pr 14:29 ; 15:18 ).
잠언-25-16.theologicalNote: 15. Gentleness and kindness overcome the most powerful and obstinate. long forbearing-- or, "slowness to anger" ( Pr 14:29 ; 15:18 ).

잠언-25-17.title: 잠언 25장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-17.exegesis: 16-17. A comparison, as a surfeit of honey produces physical disgust, so your company, however agreeable in moderation, may, if excessive, lead your friend to hate you.
잠언-25-17.theologicalNote: 16-17. A comparison, as a surfeit of honey produces physical disgust, so your company, however agreeable in moderation, may, if excessive, lead your friend to hate you.

잠언-25-18.title: 잠언 25장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-18.exegesis: 16-17. A comparison, as a surfeit of honey produces physical disgust, so your company, however agreeable in moderation, may, if excessive, lead your friend to hate you.
잠언-25-18.theologicalNote: 16-17. A comparison, as a surfeit of honey produces physical disgust, so your company, however agreeable in moderation, may, if excessive, lead your friend to hate you.

잠언-25-19.title: 잠언 25장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-19.exegesis: 18. A false witness is as destructive to reputation, as such weapons to the body ( Pr 24:28 ). beareth ... witness-- literally, "answereth questions," as before a judge, against his neighbor.
잠언-25-19.theologicalNote: 18. A false witness is as destructive to reputation, as such weapons to the body ( Pr 24:28 ). beareth ... witness-- literally, "answereth questions," as before a judge, against his neighbor.

잠언-25-20.title: 잠언 25장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-20.exegesis: 19. Treachery annoys as well as deceives.
잠언-25-20.theologicalNote: 19. Treachery annoys as well as deceives.

잠언-25-21.title: 잠언 25장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-21.exegesis: 20. Not only is the incongruity of songs (that is, joyful) and sadness meant, but an accession of sadness, by want of sympathy, is implied.
잠언-25-21.theologicalNote: 20. Not only is the incongruity of songs (that is, joyful) and sadness meant, but an accession of sadness, by want of sympathy, is implied.

잠언-25-22.title: 잠언 25장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-22.exegesis: 21-22. (Compare Mt 5:44 ; Ro 12:20 ). As metals are melted by heaping coals upon them, so is the heart softened by kindness.
잠언-25-22.theologicalNote: 21-22. (Compare Mt 5:44 ; Ro 12:20 ). As metals are melted by heaping coals upon them, so is the heart softened by kindness.

잠언-25-23.title: 잠언 25장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-23.exegesis: 21-22. (Compare Mt 5:44 ; Ro 12:20 ). As metals are melted by heaping coals upon them, so is the heart softened by kindness.
잠언-25-23.theologicalNote: 21-22. (Compare Mt 5:44 ; Ro 12:20 ). As metals are melted by heaping coals upon them, so is the heart softened by kindness.

잠언-25-24.title: 잠언 25장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-24.exegesis: 23. Better, "As the north wind bringeth forth ( Psa 90:2 ) or produces rain, so does a concealed or slandering tongue produce anger."
잠언-25-24.theologicalNote: 23. Better, "As the north wind bringeth forth ( Psa 90:2 ) or produces rain, so does a concealed or slandering tongue produce anger."

잠언-25-26.title: 잠언 25장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-26.exegesis: 25. (Compare Pr 25:13 ). good news-- that is, of some loved interest or absent friend, the more grateful as coming from afar.
잠언-25-26.theologicalNote: 25. (Compare Pr 25:13 ). good news-- that is, of some loved interest or absent friend, the more grateful as coming from afar.

잠언-25-27.title: 잠언 25장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-27.exegesis: 26. From troubled fountains and corrupt springs no healthy water is to be had, so when the righteous are oppressed by the wicked, their power for good is lessened or destroyed.
잠언-25-27.theologicalNote: 26. From troubled fountains and corrupt springs no healthy water is to be had, so when the righteous are oppressed by the wicked, their power for good is lessened or destroyed.

잠언-25-28.title: 잠언 25장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-25-28.exegesis: 27. Satiety surfeits ( Pr 25:16 ); so men who are self-glorious find shame. is not glory-- "not" is supplied from the first clause, or "is grievous," in which sense a similar word is used ( Pr 27:2 ).
잠언-25-28.theologicalNote: 27. Satiety surfeits ( Pr 25:16 ); so men who are self-glorious find shame. is not glory-- "not" is supplied from the first clause, or "is grievous," in which sense a similar word is used ( Pr 27:2 ).
